text_block_list.text:
While out with Royce and Royce,
we decided to drop by a bookstore.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: ...Hm. This bookstore has quite the well-stocked certification section, doesn't it?

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Oh, they even have study guides for the Trainer exam.
Brings back memories, doesn't it, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
I've read reference books before too, but
from the knowledge required for coaching to race regulations
and even the specific characteristics of each racetrack, it's truly exhaustive.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: Naturally, but it truly reminded me once again that Trainers are people who have overcome difficult challenges. Including you, of course.

"And after browsing the bookstore for a while
reminiscing about the exam, we stepped outside and—"

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
—Ah! R-Royce!
What do we do with this person?!

text_block_list.name: Foreign Tourist
text_block_list.text:
『Excusez-moi, vous sauriez
où je peux recharger mon
smartphone par ici ?』

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
They look like they're in trouble, but...
Uuu, Turbo doesn't understand the words...

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
“—I see. French, huh?
‘Vous voulez recharger
votre téléphone ?’”

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
『Je vois où vous pouvez le
faire, mais…… vous avez un
adaptateur ?』

text_block_list.name: Foreign Tourist
text_block_list.text: 『Oui, j’en ai un !』

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Well, that's a relief.
Looks like they were just looking for a place to charge their phone.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Royce was amazing!
She spoke so fluently!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, well, yes.
I do hold a pre-2nd grade practical French certification.
For everyday conversation, at least—

text_block_list.name: More Foreign Tourists
text_block_list.text: "Excuse me, could you tell me how to get to the art museum?"

text_block_list.name: New Foreign Tourist
text_block_list.text:
『Where can I find taiyaki!?
I wanna eat taiyaki sooo
bad!』

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
R-Royce! Before I knew it, we got surrounded!
They're all foreigners! Could this be—
choice_data_list: Do they think I'm just a friendly Japanese tourist?!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Cantonese and English, right? I can manage that
with the certifications I have! Leave it to me!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
"‘Just go straight along this road and you'll see the art museum!’
‘Do you have
a preferred filling?’"

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, I'm glad I could guide them safely.
And I got to show off the name Royce and Royce to everyone, too!
choice_data_list: ...I never expected them to speak that many languages.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Well, winning over international fans is crucial.
I've already acquired certifications for English and most languages
of countries where racing thrives!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Wh-Wh-Wh-What do I do~...?!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
What's the matter, Tannhauser-san?
In a place like this?

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
"Ugh, well...
I was just taking a little break on the way back from shopping, but...!"

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
A big spider just dived
right into my luggage...!
I can't take it home like this...!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
...I see. In that case—
I might be able to put my qualifications to good use.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
First, using this ear control I trained during
the Horse Ear Proficiency Test, I'll carefully
distinguish every single sound...!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
—No doubt about it!
The spider is inside this bag right now!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Awawa... I-I found where it is, but do you think we could get Mr. Spider to leave peacefully~...?

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: Let's see... *sniff sniff*

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Trainer.
About that plant growing over there...
Could you pluck a single leaf for me?

And once Royce and Royce
put the leaves into the bag—

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Whoa! Mr. Spider crawled out of the bag!
Why?! How come?! What did you do?!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Fufu... Thinking about the scent I wear,
I made sure to earn a
'Fragrance Specialist' certification.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: Therefore, sniffing out the minty herbs that bugs hate is a piece of cake for me!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
A-As expected of a Self-Produced Pro...!
Or Pro-Pro for short...!
choice_data_list: Just how many qualifications do you have...?
It really feels like you can solve anything.
It really feels like you can solve anything.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
A-As expected of a Self-Produced Pro...!
Or Pro-Pro for short...!
choice_data_list: Just how many qualifications do you have...?
It really feels like you can solve anything.
It really feels like you can solve anything.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Hmm. Of course, I hold racing certifications.
As well as basic qualifications in sports medicine
and therapeutic care.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
"Ah, plus 'Body Shape Analysis Master',
'Personal Color Expert',
and a few makeup-related certifications—"

"...Anyway, it was a day that really drove home
just how many qualifications Lois and Lois holds."

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, not at all. No matter how many qualifications you have,
you can never call yourself all-powerful.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
"Still... finding a goal, acquiring the knowledge to reach it
step by step, and making a habit of identifying
what you yourself need."

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
In other words: as long as your self-presentation is flawless,
there is no problem without a solution!
At least, that's what I believe!
